# IP-455 source admission evidence

Fixture preparation and measurement tools live in ../admission/. Harness task evidence lives at .devpunks/delivery/v43/IP-455/ in the integration repository. Parent owns exclusive matched native execution, canonical publication and Harness synchronization. Preparation helpers never launch native agents or decide admission. All source edits remain uncommitted/unpushed until passed measured admission or a retained explicit human exception.

`node --test tests/v43-source-admission.contract.test.mjs` proves collector arithmetic, observed descendant isolation, and unknown-data handling through the measurement seam. It does not prove delivery behavior or performance. First actual native comparison remains the telemetry gate.
